description:
Read a media object whose caption @mentions the account, by media ID.

As with mentioned comments, Meta delivers these through the "mentions" webhook rather than a list endpoint. Photo tags are a different edge — use instagram_list_tagged_media for those, which does support listing.

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the token's own account.

media_id.description: Media ID from a mentions webhook payload

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: instagram_get_mentioned_media
title: Get Mentioned Media
